fields.label: Printer address
fields.help: mqtts://<the printer's IP>:8883. The printer only speaks MQTT over TLS, on port 8883; its IP is on the screen under the network settings.
fields.patternMessage: Must start with mqtts:// - the printer only speaks TLS - like mqtts://192.168.1.60:8883.

fields.label: Access code
fields.help: Eight characters, on the printer's screen next to LAN mode.
